thread:
Aisha: heads-up: ran into a weird TS inference regression on edge builds (Vercel/Cloudflare). Works fine locally with CJS, but ESM + moduleResolution: bundler -> callers get unknown from our generic helpers.
Peter: ugh. can you paste the failing signature?
Aisha: sure:
Aisha: ```ts
// public API in sdk
export function fetchResponse<T>(input: T): Promise<ApiResponse<T>>;
export function fetchResponse(input: unknown): Promise<ApiResponse<unknown>>;
// consumers using moduleResolution:bundler see `fetchResponse({})` => ApiResponse<unknown>
```
Rohit: we added that `unknown` fallback to avoid leaking `any`, but TS overload resolution + exports map can make the generic overload unreachable in some resolver configs.
Lena: two quick options: 1) collapse to a single generic overload with a default type param, or 2) keep overloads but add `typesVersions` in package.json to point modern TS -> curated d.ts.
Peter: option 1 example: `export function fetchResponse<T = any>(input: T): Promise<ApiResponse<T>>;` then implementation uses `any` internally. It keeps inference working for consumers.
Aisha: tried the single-overload with default any — it fixed inference for Vercel edge tests. Not ideal but pragmatic.
Rohit: also check package.json `exports`/`types` conditionals. older TS picks the wrong conditional path and will pull a CJS-compatible `.d.ts` that has different overload ordering.
Lena: yep. Another trick is a tiny hand-written top-level `index.d.ts` that re-exports a flattened type surface (no internal overloads) and point `types` at it. Ugly but stable across resolvers.
Aisha: we should also document recommended consumer tsconfig: `moduleResolution: bundler|node16`, `skipLibCheck: true` note, minimum TS 4.9 in readme.
Peter: we added a reproduction earlier? if not I can scaffold one with three tsconfigs (bundler/node16/nodenext) and run `tsc --noEmit` in GH actions.
Aisha: not yet, will do. please include Vite + esbuild quick example since customers use those.
Rohit: FYI `typesVersions` lets you map older TS to a compatibility d.ts path, e.g.:
Rohit: ```json
"typesVersions": {
  ">=4.9": { "*": ["dist/types/modern/*.d.ts"] },
  "*": { "*": ["dist/types/legacy/*.d.ts"] }
}
```
Lena: and call out in changelog that ESM exports + conditional `types` can regress inference for some TS versions. Pinning minimum TS in the SDK's peer docs reduces support noise.
Aisha: opened issue #247 and will add action items: reproduce matrix, try single-overload fix, try top-level flattened d.ts, update docs.
typebot: CI: typings check failed on branch aisha/edge-typing-matrix 9 -> https://ci/redwood/typings/5678
Peter: great. when you open the PR tag `@devex` and add a tiny repro README so support can run it locally.
Aisha: will do. thanks all :pray:
